2.description: One of your experiments goes disastrously wrong. Reduce one physical characteristic by 1 and lose your Benefit rolls from this term.

3.description: Your research is discredited — you may have committed fraud, or simply been unlucky. Lose 1 SOC and gain a Rival.

4.description: A patient, subject, or colleague dies as a result of your work. Gain an Enemy among their family or colleagues.

5.description: Your funding is pulled or your institution disbands your department. You must muster out.

3.description: A research expedition goes wrong. Roll Survival 8+ or Medic 8+; on success, gain one level in that skill. On failure, lose 1 END.

4.description: You take part in a major interdisciplinary project. Gain one of Science 1, Engineer 1, Medic 1 or Electronics 1.

5.description: You present a paper or give a lecture that is well-received. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

6.description: You make a valuable Contact in academia, industry, or government.

8.description: You are given specialised training or fellowship. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one level in any Science specialty of your choice.

9.description: A rival researcher tries to scoop your work. Roll INT 8+ to publish first; on success, gain DM+2 to your next Advancement. On failure, gain a Rival.

10.description: Your research or practice attracts the notice of a powerful patron. Gain an Ally and DM+2 to your next Advancement check.

11.description: You are invited to join a major institution or expedition. Either gain one level of Admin, Advocate or Diplomat, or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.

12.description: Your work is of Imperial significance — a breakthrough, discovery or cure. You are automatically promoted and gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.
